content: {"like": ["Season 7 of \"Newhart\" is described as one of the best seasons of TV in history, with the insanity escalating and the show at its peak. The season features a guest appearance by Rebecca Schull in a book burning of Dick's books. It includes couples therapy scenes with Dick and Joanna, as well as Michael and Stephanie. Dick writes a book in collaboration with Eileen Brennen. Michael spends a month in a psychiatric hospital. George reunites with the love of his life, who, despite a one‑nighter, is still not ready to settle down. Overall, the reviewer considers this season the best so far."], "dislike": []}
